author: Tynvale
body:
I have shown this map many different times, and made many versions of it! I think I have finally come to a point where I am really proud of what it has ended up as and would love to try it out! I got some inspiration from Halcyon but other than that it was made from nothing!

AS A SIDE NOTE: I made this whole map by hand! And I haven't made lots of layers because I don't want this map to be played like all of the others. I wanted to try to kind of eliminate tunneling.

Map Name: Soul
Map Creator: Tynvale
Map Download!
Teams: 15 v 15
Team Names: Purple and Yellow
Images:



FULL GALLERY

Hope you guys like the map and please give me any feedback, good or bad!

replies.author: Hacktivism
replies.body:
It looks decent, and it's the style of map that I would enjoy PvPing on, seeing how easy it would be to knock people off the map. However, I'm going to give some constructive criticism.

- Five golden apples is way too many. Change it to two or three, that should be enough.
- Honestly, wool and grass together isn't aesthetically pleasing, at least to me. Maybe remove the wool and put it on another layer, and use some sort of stone material to border the top layer.
- The stonebrick structures on top honestly could look better. Add some more block variety to it. There's still a ton of room for improvement there.
- Monuments are in really awkward positions. Really, the only way to get to the middle monument would be bridging from spawn, which is close to impossible if you're trying to eliminate tunneling. The two side monuments could be placed better somewhere else, since your have to bridge about 20-30 blocks from the main island, with the enemy spawn right next to it.
- Side islands are too small. They should be widened, and try adding more block variety to the ground. Stone bricks on the entire island seems kinda plain.

If you took this as an insult at all, I'm sorry, it wasn't my intention. I was just trying to give tips on how the map could be improved. Fix some of the main points, and it'll be great.
